title: Three buyer lines
direction: A×C · Round 9 · /who-we-work-with §1 (the page's one ruled list)
summary: The three situations as the kit ledger that opens in place: the buyer's own line at 64px is each row (three statements in one voice, two lines each — the section's dominant element), the situation's name beside it in the key voice, and the open row's story, then what changes (no key — the sentence says it, set in the answer voice), then one plain line saying where it breaks first and spreads (both layers linked).

reference.site: GoNimbly solutions list (refs-r9/frames/detail-solutions-list.png) · the kit ledger (§6)
reference.borrowed: A short list where one item is open and shows its description, the rest stay a single line you can open.
reference.kelwin: The rows are the buyer's sentences, set large in Mona display; the kit's hairlines and +/−; the name in .ac-key (Mona 14, sentence case) in cols 1–2, the line in cols 3–11; no index, thumbnail, mono key, run-in key or red.

motion: entrance: the label fades, the three rows rise 80ms apart (kit cascade) — the page's first body play-once moment.

interaction: rows are buttons (aria-expanded / aria-controls), one open at a time, clicking the open row closes it; closed panels are inert. Closed lines rest in --fg-2 and light to --fg on hover or focus. Arriving on #founder-seller · #plateaued-motion · #misheard-category (or a later hash change) opens that row: the other rows fold at once (.is-instant, no transition), then the row is aligned to its 112px scroll margin, net of the kit cascade's 12px entrance offset — tested on the stitch (qa/r9-pages/wwww/r9fix/deep.mjs): every anchor settles at 112 (100 = 112 × 0.889 on a zoomed 1280 stage), landing and hashchange, with and without reduced motion.
on the live site: plays once as it scrolls into view. Reduced motion: final state, the founder-seller open.
story: Delivers the homepage link's promise ('Three situations, told from inside') right under the head: a buyer reads three sentences in his own voice, opens the one that is his, and learns what changes and which layer breaks first — linked to that layer's page.

notes: The page's ONE ruled list; its last row carries no rule of its own (the markets seam closes it), so there is no empty ruled band between the sections. Words at rest: 98 (one row open). Three 64px statements in one voice are one element — a list of the buyer's lines, two lines each in cols 3–11 — and the rest steps down to 20/17px. Kit gap: an inline text link in running copy (underlined, no arrow) is built here (kit_requests). Coherence pass 3: the em-dash punchlines are rewritten as plain sentences: “You’re still the best rep the company has.”; “We write your instincts down as a language other people can carry into rooms you’re not in.”; “Signal, language and learning carry over from one quarter to the next.”; “The product is genuinely different, but the market maps you onto whatever it already knows.” Final check: the two other answers no longer open on clipped slogans (‘The resets stop.’, ‘The category gets architected.’); like the founder-seller's, each is now a plain sentence that says what we do: “We keep the signal, language and learning from each quarter and carry them into the next.” and “We design the category around the problem as you name it. Buyers then compare you on your terms.”
